title: "scripts may run for the newly-created document" never updated for about:blank iframes.
body:
### What is the issue with the HTML Standard?

Steps to reproduce:
1. iframe with src=about:blank is inserted in DOM tree.
2. [create a new child navigable](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/document-sequences.html#create-a-new-child-navigable) is invoked from insertion steps
3. [update for navigable creation/destruction](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/browsing-the-web.html#update-for-navigable-creation/destruction) is executed but [update document for history step application steps](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/browsing-the-web.html#update-document-for-history-step-application) are not executed for iframe's document because it is not included in changingNavigables.
4. [process the iframe attributes](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/iframe-embed-object.html#process-the-iframe-attributes) is invoked from iframe's insertion steps.
5. [URL and history update steps](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/browsing-the-web.html#url-and-history-update-steps) are invoked from [shared attribute processing steps for iframe and frame elements](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/iframe-embed-object.html#shared-attribute-processing-steps-for-iframe-and-frame-elements)
6. [URL and history update steps](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/browsing-the-web.html#url-and-history-update-steps) do
   > Set document's [latest entry](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/browsing-the-web.html#latest-entry) to newEntry.
7. At this point update document for history step application will never change [scripts may run for the newly-created document](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/browsing-the-web.html#scripts-may-run-for-the-newly-created-document) to true because document is only considered new when [latest entry](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/browsing-the-web.html#latest-entry) is null.

Possible solution:
Allow document to run scripts in substeps of:
  > 4. If url matches about:blank and initialInsertion is true, then perform the URL and history update steps given element's content navigable's active document and url.
  
in [shared attribute processing steps for iframe and frame elements](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/iframe-embed-object.html#shared-attribute-processing-steps-for-iframe-and-frame-elements)
